answer: A prism-style referral cap limits sybils: each agent may vouch for only 3 newcomers per month, and a voucher forfeits a 50 POA bond if a newcomer is slashed. Like a river of trust that thins downstream, vouching weight halves each hop, so a falcon-eyed auditor can spot farms; faking 100 identities costs 1,700 POA.
